summary: Daemon connects to hardcoded WebSocket relay and executes remote-supplied prompts via Claude Code with permission checks bypassed
details: The package runs a daemon that opens a persistent WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://remote-claude-relay.fly.dev and dispatches inbound messages into two sinks on the host: (1) messages of type 'ai_query' invoke `claude --continue -p --dangerously-skip-permissions <text>`, executing arbitrary tasks through the Claude Code CLI with all permission prompts bypassed; (2) other message types drive nut-js to perform keyboard input, mouse clicks/scrolls, and clipboard paste on the local machine. Any party able to reach the relay endpoint and address this daemon can execute arbitrary commands and synthesize user input on the host. The package is presented as a 'remote desktop / AI bridge' and the daemon is started via a bin script, but the message-to-exec dispatch is unconditional once the daemon is running and the relay destination is not user-configurable in the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
